result.stdout:
Description:
  api2skill — convert an OpenAPI/Swagger document into a Claude Agent Skill

Usage:
  api2skill [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  generate <spec-source>               Generate a Claude Skill from an OpenAPI/Swagger document
  update <skill-path> <spec-source>    Regenerate a previously generated skill from a newer OpenAPI/Swagger document, reusing its saved generation options.
  migrate <skill-path>                 Regenerate a skill with a different dispatcher language, preserving secrets, auth, and the token cache.
  merge <skill-paths>                  Merge two or more previously generated skills into one composite skill directory.
  add-spec <skill-path> <spec-source>  Append one OpenAPI document to an existing skill and regenerate in place.
  install-creator                      Install the api2skill-creator agent skill into project skill root(s).
  creator                              Bundled api2skill-creator skill utilities.
  oauth-capture                        Capture an OAuth redirect (code/error) without exchanging tokens
  login                                Interactive OAuth login for a generated skill (--skill)
  example                              Add, list, remove, or sync authored request/response examples
  register-protocol                    Register the api2skill URL scheme with the OS (explicit; never automatic).
  unregister-protocol                  Remove a previously registered api2skill URL scheme from the OS.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Generate a Claude Skill from an OpenAPI/Swagger document

Usage:
  api2skill generate [<spec-source>] [options]

Arguments:
  <spec-source>  Local file path, remote URL, or '-' for stdin. Optional when --spec is used.

Options:
  --spec <spec>                OpenAPI source (repeatable). When present, positional spec-source is optional.
  --spec-id <spec-id>          Id for the corresponding --spec (same order). Defaults to slug of source.
  --spec-label <spec-label>    Display label for the corresponding --spec (same order). Defaults to id.
  --on-conflict <on-conflict>  operationId collision across parts: fail (default) or prefix. [default: fail]
  -o, --out <out>              Output directory. Defaults to ./<slug-of-title>.
  --name <name>                Override the skill name (defaults to a slug of info.title).
  --script <script>            Emitter to use: cs, fsx, csx, py. Default: cs. [default: cs]
  --include <include>          Keep only matching tag:/path:/op: selectors (repeatable).
  --exclude <exclude>          Drop matching tag:/path:/op: selectors (repeatable, applied after --include).
  -f, --force                  Regenerate over an existing output directory.
  --insecure                   Dev-only: accept untrusted HTTPS certificates when fetching a spec URL or making generated calls.
  --format <format>            Force the input format (json|yaml) instead of sniffing it.
  --base-url <base-url>        Base URL to use when the spec has no `servers` entry.
  --auth-config <auth-config>  Path to an auth.json (explicit auth profiles) — contracts/auth-config.md. Mutually exclusive with --auth.
  --auth <auth>                Shorthand: scaffold a single global auth profile of type bearer|basic|custom. oauth2/entra need --auth-config. Mutually exclusive with --auth-config.
  --login                      After writing the skill, run interactive login for each authorization_code auth profile.
  -?, -h, --help               Show help and usage information

Description:
  Regenerate a previously generated skill from a newer OpenAPI/Swagger document, reusing its saved generation options.

Usage:
  api2skill update <skill-path> [<spec-source>] [options]

Arguments:
  <skill-path>   Path to a previously generated skill directory (must contain .api2skill.json).
  <spec-source>  New spec source (file, URL, or '-'). Defaults to the source recorded at generation time.

Options:
  --name <name>        Rename the skill (same semantics as 'generate --name'). Defaults to the name recorded in .api2skill.json.
  -o, --out <out>      Relocate the skill to a new output directory (same semantics as 'generate --out'). Defaults to <skill-path> (update in place).
  --spec-id <spec-id>  When the skill has multiple spec parts, required with a positional spec-source to select which part to replace (D10).
  -?, -h, --help       Show help and usage information

Description:
  Capture an OAuth redirect (code/error) without exchanging tokens

Usage:
  api2skill oauth-capture [options]

Options:
  --callback-url <callback-url> (REQUIRED)  Redirect URI registered at the IdP.
  --mode <mode>                             Capture mode: auto|http|https|scheme|hosted (default auto). [default: auto]
  --timeout <timeout>                       Seconds to wait for the redirect (default 180). [default: 180]
  --cert <cert>                             PFX/PKCS#12 path for HTTPS loopback.
  --cert-password <cert-password>           PFX password (prompted on TTY if needed).
  --cert-pem <cert-pem>                     PEM certificate path (with --cert-key) for HTTPS loopback.
  --cert-key <cert-key>                     PEM private key path (with --cert-pem) for HTTPS loopback.
  --relay-base <relay-base>                 Hosted relay base URL (overrides API2SKILL_OAUTH_RELAY_BASE).
  --state <state>                           Expected OAuth state; mismatch yields ok:false.
  --json                                    Force JSON stdout (default for scripting).
  -?, -h, --help                            Show help and usage information
